notes: Draft. gbrain at the repository pin 739e5cc, the secondary link to the starting line and the pilots. gbrain init defaults: voyage:voyage-4 embedder, balanced search with the Voyage reranker. Needs VOYAGE_API_KEY. Recipe arm off LongMemEval-S.
